title: Lantern Lake Fishing [left in English, not translated]
hud.reel: Gather it in! [on its own reads as "Collect" or "Gather up"; only the fishing context makes it mean reeling in]
pass.auto_reel: Automatic gathering [could read as "Auto Collect"; only the fishing context makes it mean reeling in]
pass.lucky_bait: Lucky Bait doubles your chances of rare fish!
sell.done: You sold fish: {count}. You earned coins: {coins}! [two "label: number" phrases in a row; clear but stiff]
ascend.button: Ascent [bare noun meaning "ascent" or "rise"; vague as a button label on its own]
ascend.confirm: Ascend now? You will start over from the beginning, but you will catch rare fish {bonus}% more often.
weather.storm: A storm is coming! The rare fish are biting.
quest.title: Quests
quest.catch_n: Catch fish at Moonlit Bay: {n} [number tacked on after a colon; reads like a form label, and it is unclear whether {n} is a target or progress]
trade.sent: Trade request sent to: {player} [colon right after the preposition "to" is a little unnatural]
codes.enter: Type code [the word for "code" also commonly means "password" in Greek; in a text box this could read as "Enter password"]
codes.redeemed: The code was redeemed! Enjoy your gift.
afk.kicked: You went too long without playing, so the fishing stopped.
daily.streak: Streak: day {day}! Come back tomorrow for more gifts.
tip.night: Tip: some fish only bite at night.
group.join: Join our community and get 50 free baits!
